import numpy as np
def _mk(n, N, seed, dx=1.0):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    Xp = np.sort(rng.uniform(0.0, (n - 1) * dx, N))
    Mp = rng.uniform(0.5, 1.5, N)
    return Xp, Mp, dx, rng
def _ops(Xp, Mp, n, dx):
    Xp = np.asarray(Xp, dtype=np.float64); Mp = np.asarray(Mp, dtype=np.float64)
    N = Xp.size
    xi = np.arange(n, dtype=np.float64) * dx
    S = 1.0 - np.abs(Xp[:, None] - xi[None, :]) / dx
    S = np.where(S > 0.0, S, 0.0)
    m = (S * Mp[:, None]).sum(axis=0)
    act = m > 0.0
    Sp = np.zeros_like(S)
    Sp[:, act] = (Mp[:, None] * S[:, act]) / m[None, act]
    out = np.zeros((2 * N + 1, n), dtype=np.float64)
    out[0:N, :] = S; out[N:2 * N, :] = Sp; out[2 * N, :] = m
    return out
n=10
N=14
Xp, Mp, dx, rng = _mk(n, N, 1)
assert np.allclose(fmpm_grid_operators(Xp, Mp, n, dx), target)
